hero_headline:
A prestigious
Waterloo address,
*without the overhead.*
hero_subhead: Register your business at 14 Erb St. W., Den 1880's heritage building in the heart of Uptown Waterloo. Get professional mail handling, a business address, and a virtual presence, starting at $88/month.
how_subhead: Getting your business address set up takes less than a week.
step1_desc: Submit your application online. We'll review it within 1 to 2 business days.
step2_desc: Once approved, we send your Virtual Services Agreement via Optix for digital signature.
step3_desc: Sign your agreement and your business address at 14 Erb St. W. is officially active.
step4_desc: We'll notify you by email the moment mail or packages arrive. Collect at your convenience.
inclusions_subhead: Your base membership covers everything a growing business needs for a professional address presence.
addons_subhead: Enhance your Business Mail membership with services tailored to how your business operates.
addon1_desc: Add a dedicated suite number to your mailing address. Useful for businesses that want a more complete address line or need to differentiate from other tenants.
addon2_desc: Register additional individuals to receive mail at your address. Each name beyond your two included contacts is billed at $8/month.
addon3_desc: Get a dedicated local Waterloo phone number with voicemail-to-email forwarding. Calls are handled with your business name, giving you a professional phone presence.
addon4_desc: Authorize Den 1880 to receive and securely store packages and parcels on your behalf. Includes notification on arrival and secure storage until pick-up.
address_headline: Uptown Waterloo's most recognized business address
address_subhead: 14 Erb St. W. is a century-old heritage building in the heart of Uptown Waterloo, steps from the LRT and surrounded by Waterloo's most vibrant restaurants, shops, and businesses.
final_subhead: Fill out the form and we'll have your application reviewed within 1 to 2 business days. Questions welcome anytime at hello@den1880.co.
